A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same SAMRefiner research work, with readable text, equations, tables, figures and Appendices A–E. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable comparison throughout.

before.justification: v1 reports original mask-refinement and segmentation experiments, component ablations and qualitative analyses in Section 4 and the appendices, including evaluations on DAVIS-585, COCO and VOC.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and analyses, including SAMRefiner and SAMRefiner++ results in Table 1 and additional benchmark evaluations in Appendix B.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain identical prompt excavation, context-aware elastic boxes, Gaussian-style masks, split-then-merge processing and optional IoU adaptation. No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same DAVIS-585, COCO, VOC, BIG and relabeled-VOC coverage, including COCO evaluation with LVIS annotations and human-annotation correction. No task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the corresponding experiments, including dense CRF, CascadePSP, CRM and SegRefiner in Table 5 and the automatic-grid Max IoU and Merge comparisons in Table 7.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendices A–B retain the same data subsets, metrics, preprocessing, model configurations, training budgets and evaluation procedures. No experimental setting is revised.

E4.justification: The prompt and STM ablations, backbone and cascade experiments, hyperparameter sensitivity analyses, and coarse-mask failure cases are unchanged in Section 4.2 and the appendices.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests for the experimental results.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted trends and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, Table 1 reports the same all-prompt IoU values of 86.9/87.1 for SAMRefiner/SAMRefiner++, and Appendix B retains identical additional results.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations (1)–(4), including feature similarity, Gaussian masks and the ranking loss, are identical. No formal assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about universal mask refinement, noise-tolerant prompts, optional annotation-free IoU adaptation, accuracy and efficiency.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations and applicability qualifications are unchanged. Appendices C–D retain the same limitations concerning extremely coarse masks, semantic ambiguity, multiple objects and the dataset-dependent applicability of SAMRefiner++.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, runtime information and the code-link target are unchanged. The added funding acknowledgment provides no new technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2, the prior-work comparisons and the complete reference contents are unchanged. Bibliography entries move between pages because of the acknowledgment insertion, without adding or removing cited works.

P1.justification: v2 expands Xiaofei He's and Ping Luo's affiliations, marks Zheng Yang as an additional corresponding author, and adds Section 6 acknowledging funding. The scientific prose and remaining section structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The title-page affiliation block changes, and the acknowledgment shifts reference placement across pages 11–14. All figures, tables and appendix layouts remain unchanged; rendered pages 2–10 and 15–25 are identical.

improvement.justification: v2 updates author attribution and adds funding disclosure, with limited accompanying layout changes. The scientific argument, experimental evidence, technical documentation and limitations are identical, leaving overall paper quality effectively unchanged.
